   **Баги и стабильность.**
      18 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 22 июл. 2026 г. - 12 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _MichaelMather2026_, 11 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "Had been using this for years. My god what is this new interface update. Super buggy, blocks that I deleted keeping magically reappearing. The app even adds random blocks I never created. What on earth is going on over there at Opal. How can it be this bad."
            2. _Tomito6_, 2 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "I payed this app for almost a year. Not worth it at all! I found a much better app that was not 20€ per month. And let me tell you that this app also often didn’t work. It’s super buggy!! For some reason my instagram always seemed to unlock between 23-24 (even if I put a lot of extra rules or changed stuff) it also often didn’t revognize time limits so it’s quite literally not doing it’s only purpose, while demanding 20€. Hoooorrrribble app. Migrated to a new one and wish I could go back in time to avoid this scam"
            3. _AverageMean_, 13 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
